definitions.profile_complexity: number of distinct profiles except the all-infinity vector; pc_r(G,k) maximizes over |A|=k
definitions.simple_treewidth: minimum t such that G is a subgraph of a simple t-tree; a t-clique is not reused to attach two different vertices

verified_bounds.simple_treewidth_conjecture: for each fixed t, O_t(r^t k); t=3 target O(r^3 k)

claims.scope: all graphs of ordinary treewidth at most fixed t

claims.verification: explicit K_3,3 minor model; every simple 3-tree is planar

claims.status: no proof and no counterexample to all possible families

claims.statement: pc_r(H,A)<=4|A|(16(r+1)+1)^2 for a maximal simple 3-tree H
claims.does_not_cover: proper subgraphs G of H, whose distances may change after edge deletion

claims.statement: For each standard LCA guard S and its assigned vertices X_S in any G subgraph of a simple 3-tree, the number of truncated G-distance vectors on S is O(r^3), uniformly.

proof_obligations.obligation: Prove a uniform O(r^3) joint signature bound for vertices assigned to each LCA guard of a partial simple-3-tree subgraph, especially two-sided regions, or construct an asymptotic counterexample.

decision.reason: The main conjecture remains unresolved; only a low-novelty host-only corollary was proved. No successor task is created.
decision.publication_value: Low for the host-only corollary; no publication-level result on simple-treewidth-3 subgraphs established.
